item_name: Failure to Complete Required In-Service Training for Home Health Aide
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol states an annual training requirement ("a minimum of 12 hours of in-service training education per year") but does not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days for this audit area.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Home health aides require a minimum of 12 hours of in-service training education per year.

source.quote: Home health aides require a minimum of 12 hours of in-service training education per year.

state_deltas.delta: New York State OMIG audit protocol for the Assisted Living Program requires documentation in the personnel record of a minimum of 12 hours per year of in-service training for home health aides; failure results in disallowance of the claim. Applies to service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.
